name: qr-generator
desc: Free, open-source QR code generator for Windows — offline codes for links, Wi-Fi and contacts, export PNG or SVG. 100 MB portable, MIT.
features: ✅ **Template types** — URL, text, Wi-Fi join, vCard contact, email and SMS payloads built from forms
✅ **Error-correction control** — L to H levels with live preview of density so damaged prints still scan
✅ **PNG and SVG export** — vector output for print shops, 128 to 2048 px PNG for screens
✅ **Batch from CSV** — generate hundreds of codes from a spreadsheet column with auto-naming
✅ **Quiet zone and styling** — margin, foreground and background colors, rounded module toggle
✅ **Scan-test pane** — internal decoder verifies the code reads before you print it
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime and encoding libraries bundled, portable, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Price | **Free, MIT** | Freemium | Free, OSS | Paid |
| Wi-Fi and vCard templates | **Yes** | Paid tier | Manual string | Paid tier |
| SVG for print | **Yes** | Paid tier | Yes | Yes |
| Batch from CSV | **Yes** | No | Scripted | No |
| Portable GUI, offline | **Yes, 100 MB** | Web | CLI | Web |
faqQ: how to generate QR codes offline without uploading data?
faqA: Most QR sites make you paste passwords and Wi-Fi keys into a form that logs them, which is exactly wrong for a Wi-Fi join code. qr-generator builds codes locally from templates, exports SVG for print and even scan-tests the result before you ship it. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, fully offline.
s1: Dark studio (#121417, yellow #FDE047): template picker left (URL, Wi-Fi, vCard), form fields center, QR preview right with error-correction selector.
s2: Wi-Fi template filled: SSID and password fields masked, security dropdown WPA2, join QR rendering with logo-free preview at 512 px.
s3: Batch panel: CSV preview with three columns, naming pattern field, 240 codes progress bar at 57 percent, export folder selection.
